content: संक्षेपः .²1 Throwing together. .²2 Compression, abridgment. .²3 Brevity, conciseness. .²4 An epitome, a brief exposition. .²5 Throwing, sending. .²6 Taking away. .²7 Assisting in anotherʼs duty. .²8 Destruction (संहार); प्रजासंक्षेपसमये दण्डहस्तामिवान्तकम् <ls>Mb. 3. 155. 27</ls>. .²9 Total, aggregate. (संक्षेपेण, संक्षेपतस् are used adverbially in the sense of briefly, concisely, shortly; <ls>Kull.</ls> on <ls>Ms. 1. 68.</ls>)
